name: Daybreak Squadron: Dawnlance
description:
A flamboyant warrior and the eldest of the group, though not the brightest. She sees herself as the team's guardian but always ends up as the comic relief.
"Look, I did say I'd protect you from the creepy-crawlies, but isn't this one a bit... excessively massive!? STAY AWAY FROM ME, KYAAAAA!!!"
Dispelling the eternal night! A radiance like a blazing torch! The shining prayer — Dawnlance Warrior!
Darkness wanes, and dawn awakens! The Daybreak Squadron arises!

skills.name: Daybreak Blade
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Daybreak Flywheel
skills.description: Deals Imaginary DMG to one designated target and adjacent targets.

skills.name: Daybreak Will
skills.description: Applies "Daybreak Forcefield" to this unit. While in this state, Daybreak Squadron is immune to DMG of its own Type and continuously uses "Shadow Dance of the Daybreak Blade." It is also immune to Crowd Control debuffs, and its Toughness cannot be reduced. When Daybreak Squadron is in the "Daybreak Forcefield" state, it uses "Daybreak Dispersal" after being attacked a certain number of times. If an attack deals <u>Elation DMG</u>, that attack instead increases the tally by <unbreak>3[i]</unbreak>.

skills.name: Shadow Dance of the Daybreak Blade
skills.description: Deals massive Imaginary DMG to one designated target.

skills.name: Daybreak Dispersal
skills.description: Dispels "Daybreak Forcefield," loses a certain amount of HP, and applies "Disheartened" to this unit, increasing DMG taken and reducing this unit's Imaginary RES.
